title: Authenticate publisher metadata separately from the real staging execution

source.ref: Actual staging43642752486 returned one successful real db-tests job and two failed zero-step migration-readiness publisher checks; trusted proof43644453727 incorrectly refused the suite.

detail: The collector and atomic apply planner share a strict staging inventory classifier. Exactly one successful real db-tests runner with authenticated GitHub Actions check supplies required replay, TAP, API and cleanup steps. Extra entries are excluded only when they are zero-step/null-runner migration-readiness metadata with matching host run/attempt/head, canonical check identity, GitHub Actions app, exact PR/base/head external identity, official details URL and authenticated original trusted workflow run attempt/repository/event/path. Metadata result is intentionally irrelevant because the current publisher may itself be running or failed. Every other extra job, failed real execution, forged binding or missing required step still refuses. Existing assertions and workflow, SQL, policy and frozen probes remain unchanged; only positive fixture metadata is strengthened. No production SQL was dispatched. Baseline actual three-job collector regression fails against main with incomplete staging job inventory; implementation passes149 focused tests across3 suites and changed-file ESLint. Required backlog passes2704 entries/1011 probes. Root and independent provenance review pass. Both original publisher run-attempt API reads confirm matching repository/head_repository, candidate head, pull_request_target event, workflow398404199 and canonical workflow path. No result requirement was added to the non-executing metadata.
